object.attr: analysis: a character dropped from the PDF, a less-than-or-equal sign for instance, changes what a requirement says while the PDF looks complete (CF-P26). The printable characters are those MELLON-PDF-SRS-136 requires (review Q3, decided on 2026-11-11), so this has a test.
object.description: If the document's text that the exported PDF shows holds a character that is neither whitespace nor a printable character, Mellon shall report with the export result the object ID and the character.
